title: High-Throughput Batch Vector Ingestion: n8n SOP
description: [BOFU - ETL Rate-Limiting Protocol] Optimizing n8n workflows for high-throughput batch vector ingestion into Qdrant using sub-workflows, concurrency control, and rate limiting.

children.text: What is High-Throughput Batch Vector Ingestion in n8n & Qdrant?

High-throughput batch vector ingestion in n8n requires splitting large document datasets into parallel sub-workflow execution batches, enforcing rate limits, and using Qdrant's batch upsert API. This architecture prevents n8n memory spikes and API rate-limit errors when vectorizing millions of text tokens simultaneously.
